candidate: GATE-RS1: T11-gate-derived long-equity selector, not faithful T11
cash: Residual USD; no cash ETF substitution or assumed interest.
changed_stage: Replace position proposal only; no retained original T11 branch eligibility in this first ranking variant.

selection_rule.features: For each actual ETF total-return close index TR, momentum = TR[t]/TR[t-252]-1; volatility = sample standard deviation of last63 daily simple total returns times sqrt(252). Score = momentum/volatility. This is not a Sharpe estimate or a perfect removal of leverage effects.
selection_rule.eligibility: All six series must have complete common-calendar causal coverage and253 closes; ETF must have positive252-session momentum and volatility greater than1e-12. Zero volatility is undefined/ineligible with a reason, not a favorable infinite score. Invalid source/state blocks the case.
selection_rule.timing: Rank at last common regular-session completed close of each calendar month, only after actual bar availability; first allocation at first qualified evaluation decision with prior warmup. Execute through unchanged next-open staged controller, never same-close fill.
selection_rule.ranking: Descending score, then ascending ticker for exact ties; greedily take at most two ETFs, at most one from each declared family.
selection_rule.weights: Each selected ETF receives0.5 normalized pre-gate weight. With only one eligible family, retain the other half as cash. None eligible means cash.
selection_rule.between_rankings: Persist selected normalized proposal until next ranking. Existing daily gate can scale or zero it; gate recovery can reenable that persisted proposal. No extra daily trend exit, debounce, volatility sizing or buy-topup maintenance is added.
selection_rule.gate_and_reserve: Original SPY traffic-light cap1/0.5/0 and90% reserve applied once, unchanged.
selection_rule.limitation: Declared families remove exact wrapper duplication only; technology, Nasdaq, semiconductor and broad-market holdings still overlap. Ranking may change implicit leverage, not just predictive quality.

policies: original T11 restricted to permitted weights, excluded weight becomes cash without renormalization
fixed equal-family allowed-universe allocation plus gate
half-sized fixed equal-family control plus gate
comparison_proposal.equal_family_execution: Constant normalized proposal, unchanged signal-change controller; not continuous daily equal-weight maintenance. Half-sized control scales proposal by0.5.
comparison_proposal.accounting: Match original staged controller, IB fees, affordability reserves,6% ACT/360 prior debit and zero cash credit. Actual ETF paths and corporate actions, not leveraged proxy reconstruction. Original gate seed retained.
comparison_proposal.proposed_screen: At both costs: closing-path Calmar at least10% above both restricted-T11 and fixed equal-family controls, CAGR at least90% of each, drawdown no deeper and recovery-inclusive maximum underwater sessions/calendar days no longer. Full gated T11 remains external research benchmark; report failure to beat it explicitly.
comparison_proposal.inference_limit: Half-sized reference is not exact exposure matching. A passing result supports only the modeled combined allocation; timing/selection alpha remains unassessed without credible exposure attribution or matched controls.
comparison_proposal.stop: No launch before qualified input, source/reuse/execution-route and capture/accounting gates; stop on unresolved integrity/capture failure. All attempts count, no parameter sweep.

research_status: Viewed-history development proposal; no guarantee of improvement, no untouched holdout, no ML training or financial cases.
